The real producer path is resolved against the configured recovery-volume root and stored server-side only in recovery_volume_path, which BackupController never serializes (BackupArtefactSummary carries no path field).

unresolved_risks: ui2/persistence/src/main/java/com/securityexpert/nexus/ui2/persistence/artefact/BackupArtefactRetrieval.java (CLI retrieval, OR-2..OR-5) is explicitly out of scope for this movement (WORKER.md 'must not touch': retrieval/download/restore). It currently does `new ArtefactRef(artefactId)` at line 90, which only resolved to the correct file because artefact_id used to equal the storage-relative path. After this fix, artefact_id is the opaque ciphertext digest and no longer resolves to a file location by itself; the real per-artefact locator now lives only in recovery_volume_path, which BackupArtefactManifestRepository.RetrievalManifest does not currently expose to that caller. BackupArtefactRetrievalTest does not catch this because its FakeArtefactStore.retrieve() ignores the ArtefactRef argument entirely -- the break is silent under every existing automated test. A follow-up movement owning that file needs to thread recovery_volume_path (not artefact_id) through to retrieval. Not fixed here because the file is explicitly reserved out of scope for NXS-LOCAL-0225.
